title: What the expert cannot see
lines: An expert sees the flaw everyone else missed, then overlooks the world outside that expertise.
The Blind Specialist challenges the habit of treating deep knowledge in one field as authority over everything else.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Recognize how expertise's necessary selectivity can become unjustified authority outside its scope.
emotionalPlan.visualActing: Bring the inspection lens over one fault while keeping the neighboring seam visible.
voiceDirections: Warm recognition; gently emphasize “outside that expertise”. Let the sentence land in an ordinary speaking voice, with no dramatic swell.
Clear and warmly interested; give a small emphasis to “deep knowledge in one field”, then finish at an ordinary conversational pace without a dramatic rise.
